name: vscx-workspace
description: A local control plane for the running VS Code extension host.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vscx/core run build && pnpm --filter @vscx/cli run build && pnpm --filter vscx run build
scripts.check: node scripts/sync-runtime-version.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @vscx/core run check && pnpm --filter @vscx/core run build && pnpm --filter @vscx/cli run check && pnpm --filter @vscx/cli run build && pnpm --filter vscx run check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @vscx/core run test && pnpm --filter @vscx/cli run test
scripts.release:verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm package:pre-release
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:verify && pnpm release:validate && pnpm changeset publish && pnpm release:publish:vscode
